archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / TACTICAL ENTERPRISE B2B
emotional_tone: Authoritative, data-dense, razor-sharp, friction-free enterprise precision

typography.body_font: IBM Plex Sans, DM Sans, sans-serif

forbidden_rules: FORBIDDEN: Teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) anywhere in color palette
FORBIDDEN: Inter font family for Main or Sub-headings (Inter allowed for dense data text only)
FORBIDDEN: Public marketing header or landing page (App starts at Login/Activation)
FORBIDDEN: Generic centered app containers or full screen blur overlays without content legibility
FORBIDDEN: Toast notifications for routine non-confirmations (Toasts strictly reserved for explicit state changes like transfers/unassign/placements/creations)
FORBIDDEN: Pure black #000000 or pure transparent overlays without backdrop filter/scrim

layout_and_density.type: Mode B - High Density Enterprise Grid
layout_and_density.table_density: Compact (cell py-2 px-3, text-xs/sm, strict truncation, zero overflow)
layout_and_density.spacing: Dense enterprise layout with generous card margins (gap-4 to gap-6), tight content padding (p-3 to p-5)
layout_and_density.sidebar_behavior: Collapsible sticky sidebar with multi-tenant consultancy dropdown, active group indicator, quick global search (Cmd+K)

component_design_patterns.tables: Sticky header, alternating row background, hover highlight, inline action buttons with permission badges, bulk selection bar with active count.
component_design_patterns.modal_dialogs: Strong confirmation dialogs requiring typed confirmation string (e.g. 'TRANSFER' or 'UNASSIGN') for irreversible operations.
component_design_patterns.forms: Keyboard-friendly focus order, inline real-time duplicate check with warning banner, auto-formatting phone/email/SSN, clear error validation states.
component_design_patterns.badges: High contrast APCA approved status badges with dot indicators (Active, Bench, In Interview, Placed, Offboarded, Quarantined).
component_design_patterns.kanban_marketing: Column-based drag & drop with candidate card summary (Skill tags, Experience, Hourly rate target, Active sub-count, Quarantine badge).
component_design_patterns.quarantine_scanner: Versioned document rows featuring scanning status (Clean - Green Shield, Scanning - Amber Spinner, Quarantined - Red Alert with details).

avatars.description: Consultant Marcus Vance - Senior Cloud Architect
Consultant Sarah Jenkins - Lead Data Engineer
Consultant Priya Sharma - Full Stack Developer

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement desktop-first, highly responsive internal recruitment dashboard for consultancies with role-based access control (Admin, Operations/HR, Lead, Recruiter, Marketing, Viewer, Auditor).
Strictly follow the color system with high-contrast APCA status badges. NEVER use #1B93A4 teal.
Header and section titles MUST use Outfit/Manrope font family, not Space Grotesk or Inter.
Ensure every candidate row, transfer button, modal confirmation input, and status badge includes its specified data-testid attribute.
Use sonner library for toasts upon completing transfer, placement, unassign, or document quarantine updates.

Provide seed/mock data rich with realistic consultancy candidates, bench status, marketing submissions, multi-tenant groups, versioned documents with malware scanner badges, and detailed audit log events.
